product_metadata.title: oylik Upgrade Water Bottle Organizer for Cabinet, 16.5'' Expandable Water Bottle Storage Rack, 2-Shelf Height Adjustable Water Bottle Holder for Cabinet, Pantry, Countertop (Holds Up to 10 Bottles)
features: 【16.5'' Rack Expanded & Height Adjustable】The water bottle storage organizer can be expanded horizontally up to 16.5'' to store more water bottles. You can also adjust the spacing between the tiers according to your water bottle sizes, quantities and storage space, without worrying about the size of the bottles, no matter 14oz, 18oz, 32oz or 64oz water bottles, Insulated Tumbler Sports Flask Bottles, Kids Water Bottles, Travel Mugs,etc.

【Upgraded Water Bottle Holder, Easier to Install】Based on customer feedback regarding their experience using the product, we have made modifications and upgrades to the installation structure of the water bottle organizer. Previously, it was necessary to identify the correct installation direction to ensure more stable. Now, the iron frame can be installed on either side, making it easier for you to install this tumbler organizer for kitchen cabinets.

【Universal Use, Organize your Space】This water bottle shelf organizer is suitable for cabinets, countertop and pantry, which can better organize your space. Besides, the water bottle shelves it easy to find and remove stainless steel water bottles, glass water bottles and insulated bottles. Ideal for sports and exercise enthusiasts, as well as busy families. In addition, the bottle organizer is also suitable for cola cans, water cups with straws, and package of ziplock bags.

【Premium Quality, Durability】The material of the water bottle storage is ABS plastic and coated metal. High-quality ABS plastic shelf in full coverage can bear greater weight, not easy to crack. The coated metal rack is thick to make this water bottle holder strong and steady.You don't have to worry about shake after installation and fading or rusting.
【Detail Design, Stability】The stackable bottle organizer comes with a silicone pad at the bottom, which plays a non-slip role and makes the water bottle storage rack more stable.
